name: Tasty Shame in Silver Soul!
source:
Welcome, the newcomer! We are glad to see you in the Silver Soul academy - the place where you can embody all your passionate dreams. You’ll face the difficult choice: there are so many pretty girls here. Dip into the real power of love and adventures, but don’t forget about the lessons - you’re not going to be expelled, huh?
Choose your way - an impressive macho; а geek ruled by the public opinion; or a simple school guy dreaming about a real love.
Hold your breath and play our amazing Sweet Time game!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎，新人！我们很高兴在银魂学院见到你——在这里你可以实现所有热情的梦想。你将面临艰难的选择：这里有这么多漂亮的女孩。深入了解爱和冒险的真正力量，但不要忘记教训 - 你不会被开除，对吧？
选择你的方式 - 令人印象深刻的男子气概；一个被舆论统治的极客；或者是一个梦想着真爱的普通学生。
屏住呼吸，玩我们精彩的甜蜜时光游戏！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1412620/]Steam[/url]]
